title: Refill Timing Convention: Days Added to a Courtesy Reship of Test Strips
content:
Whether the refill a courtesy reship stands in for shipped on a recorded confirmation changes how long the courtesy reship on the Blood Glucose Testing Supply Program carries the customer.

**Convention.** Days are added to the days the reship covers: the tier's refill ship lead days when the refill stood in for shipped on the customer's recorded refill confirmation on a tier whose supply days per shipment are 90, because the next 90-day refill ships only once the customer confirms it again; the tier's refill ship lead less its refill reminder lead, which takes days off where the reminder lead is the longer, when that refill shipped on a recorded confirmation on a tier whose supply days per shipment are 30, because the next refill then waits on Larkfield's refill contact; and none otherwise.

A refill shipped on a recorded confirmation is one whose shipment record shows a refill confirmation date.

| Tier | Supply days per shipment | Refill reminder lead, days | Refill ship lead, days | Days added with a recorded confirmation | Without one |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Testing Supplies Self-Pay Program | 30 | 7 | 7 | 0 | none |
| Testing Supplies Commercial HMO Program | 30 | 10 | 7 | 3 taken off | none |
| Testing Supplies Commercial PPO Program | 90 | 10 | 10 | 10 added | none |
| Testing Supplies Medicare Advantage Program | 90 | 14 | 10 | 10 added | none |
| Testing Supplies Original Medicare Program | 90 | 14 | 10 | 10 added | none |
| Testing Supplies Medicaid Program | 30 | 14 | 7 | 7 taken off | none |

**Examples (hypothetical days covered)**

- 55 days covered, the refill stood in for confirmed on a 90-day tier with a 10-day ship lead: 65 days.
- The 30-day block, the refill confirmed on a 30-day tier with a 7-day ship lead and a 10-day reminder lead: 27 days.
- Any days covered, the refill shipped without a confirmation date: unchanged.
